execution_log.summary: Opus worker, supervisor review against the live tree. New unit dir kcl/tgrep: tgrep.sh (403 lines) sources ../tutil/tutil.sh; class TGrep : TUtil with the 22 typed vars of PLAN §1.3 plus a private 23rd `_nulDerived`; Create = `parent.constructor grep` (explicit, never `inherited`) + every var assigned + ${inst}_paths; Destroy frees _paths then inherited; paths replaces the operand list; buildArgv override in the PINNED order with the rc 2 list (cmd/pattern empty, -F+-E, -l+-L, -h+-H, maxCount not an int or negative via $__KK_INT without writing back) and the §2.7 derivation (-Z with -l/-L -> nul=1, recorded in _nulDerived so the derivation is UNDONE when the condition stops holding and a caller-set nul is never touched — the brief's set-only rule was not idempotent, worker deviation accepted); mapRc override (0->0, 1->1 silent, >=2->1 + one debug line, 127->1 + debug); static search = `grep -r` on a throw-away instance `__tg_s_${BASHPID}_${__TG_SEQ}`, >=1 path required (rc 2). GNU grep 3.0 under both bashes (msys and cygwin builds); real NTFS symlinks and a newline-in-name fixture were creatable, so no case degraded to SKIP. Red-first against the stubbed skeleton: 143 FAIL of 174 (004: 62/73, 005: 49/53, 006: 32/48). Green: 174/174 on 5.2.37 AND 5.3.9, threaded and --mode single; tutil 164/164 and tpipe 171/171 re-proved. G1–G12 each pinned (see the worker table in the P2 review): argv byte-exact per flag and in combination, -e always, -- iff paths, addArg slot, the four rc 2 pairs, maxCount 08->8 / +5->5 / -1 rc 2, pattern -v/--help/-e/newline as data, no-match rc 1 silent, -E + `(` rc 1 lastRc 2 one line vs literal `(` without -E, -l -Z names with a space and a newline intact while -c -Z stays \n-framed, directory without recursive rc 1 lastRc 2, search byte-identical to bare grep -r in three positions, the three forms equal under lastpipe (n=2/2/2), partial failure keeps records with rc 1 lastRc 2 (named deviation), nested search keeps the outer instance, -r skips a real directory symlink while -R descends and a command-line symlink is followed, CRLF table (text mode strips CR, binary=1 keeps it), Binary-file record + addArg -a. No TUtil change was needed. Reviewer probes on both bashes: the owner's flagship `TGrep.search needle DIR | TPipe.each r.onLine` == `TPipe.each r.onLine -- TGrep.search …` == `g.each r.onLine` with r's counter at 3 in all three forms, argv `grep -i -r -n -m 8 -e needle -- DIR`, bad ERE rc 1/lastRc 2, search without a path rc 2, CRLF text vs binary, partial failure, delete frees _paths. Master sweep: 23/23 suites 0 [FAIL] on 5.2.37 and 5.3.9. Committed as kcl <SHA-TU2>.

PLAN.md + this ledger written after the owner accepted the TPipe/TUtil/TGrep design. TUtil is concrete (generic argv runner, TProcess kinship), buildArgv/mapRc virtual, three per-instance arrays freed by the destructor, all sinks delegate to TPipe. TGrep argv shape pinned (grep [flags] -e PATTERN [extras] -- PATH...), no -P/--color/context. §7 template for tsed/tawk/tfind/thead/ttail. No code.

Opus critic, 23 probe scripts on both bashes (scratchpad critic_tutil/; base.sh/derived.sh = faithful TUtil/TGrep per the draft). BLOCKERS: (1) `$this.func` inside a member prints the callee's kk._return under $( )/|/<( ) — run leaked '2…0' into its stream; fix = kk.call_silent for every internal member call. (2) `inherited` in a constructor is rewritten to `parent.constructor "$@"` (kklass_pascal.sh:166) — TGrep paths doubled; fix = explicit `parent.constructor grep`. (3) an unassigned `var` is an unbound variable under set -u (kklass.sh:363) and .new over a live instance keeps stale _data; fix = constructor assigns every var. (4) G8 and the flagship example contradicted (grep DIR without -r = rc 2, zero records); fix = `search` implies -r and requires ≥1 path, instances never imply -r. (5) `RESULT=n; return 1` in a func loses RESULT (explicit return skips the trailer, kk._invoke restores the caller's); fix = `kk._return n; return m` ordering. MAJORS: `(` is literal under BRE (G6 needs -E); plain `ln -s` makes a directory copy on this box → kt_make_symlink; grep/sed/gawk strip CR in text mode (crlf is a no-op for them) → `binary` (-U) var; a test's own EXIT trap replaces ktests' trap → framework fixtures; -Z is NUL termination only with -l/-L and a var cannot set `nul` → derived -0; grep rc 2 with partial hits and 'Binary file X matches' on stdout → named deviation + escape hatch; bare "${argv[@]}" aborts a set -e caller → `|| rc=$?`; fixed throw-away name clobbered by nested search → BASHPID+seq; non-GNU grep on PATH (Embarcadero) → GNU banner gate; missing cmd prints bash's own unconditional stderr → `command -v` pre-check. MINOR/NIT: var-vs-inherited-method same name (method wins silently) → reserved names; kk.isInt accepts negatives and the OUTVAR form writes through the property nameref → $__KK_INT and >= 0; -h/-H and -l/-L pairs rc 2; empty pattern rc 2; sed `--` asymmetry explained; TStringList.Add may answer rc 1 (TPipe guards it); out-name helper status converted to 2; func stubs must kk._return a sentinel. 18 claims verified correct and listed in PLAN §8.
